root.label: Justin Bataga Mugarwa and Rebecca die of Ebola in Rwampara

events.label: Justin Bataga Mugarwa and Rebecca die of Ebola in Rwampara

slots.name: age of patient
slots.sentence: Mr. Mugarwa, 42, had been at the ward for nearly a week, and his sudden decline began with delirium, followed by convulsions so violent that doctors dragged his mattress and their patient onto the floor to prevent a fall.

slots.name: death date
slots.sentence: He vomited blood. His internal organs failed. One of the doctors treating him slumped on the metal bed frame and stared down at Mr. Mugarwa as his breathing slowed. Then it stopped. He was gone.

slots.name: burial date
slots.sentence: Mr. Mugarwa and his niece were buried at a cemetery across the road from the clinic the day after they died.
